messages:
erin: Heads up — new user reported quickstart-node crash when using json_mode + strict schema while calling a tool. Parser error: "type mismatch: expected object got string".

kai: Do we have logs/raw response?

erin: Raw shows quoted payloads like ""{}"" or sometimes ""[]"" after a retry. On python quickstart it yields {}.

mona: That sounds like double-stringify in the retry/auth layer or a normalize helper returning a string for empty payloads.

erin: Minimal repro: stub tool returns 204 empty body, run quickstart-node with json_mode=true and strict schema.

sam: I can reproduce. Node helper normalizeToolOutput returns string when body is falsy because it tries JSON.parse and falls back to returning original raw. But some interceptors wrap the raw in quotes.

kai: Created DEVEX-5401: "node-sdk normalizeToolOutput treats empty tool output as quoted string" and assigned to sam.

mona: Short fix: treat quoted-empty patterns (""{}"", ""[]"") as raw JSON and parse them down to {} or []. Also audit retry wrapper to avoid re-stringifying base64/log payloads into request/response.

sam: Pushed small guard in branch that trims matching outer quotes and attempts parse once more before falling back. Added unit test for 204 empty-body -> {}. https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/2401

erin: Can we also add a samplekit quick integration that runs both node and python quickstarts and asserts identical tool outputs? That would catch parity regressions.

kai: Agreed — adding integration test to sample-quickstarts CI. Filed follow-up DEVEX-5402.

_devex-bot: DEVEX-5401 status: in_progress (assignee: sam)_

sam: Merged and cut node-sdk v0.6.5 patch. Sample quickstart updated to include a note about empty-tool behavior and a temporary client-side post-coercion fallback for onboarding.

erin: Verified v0.6.5 fixes parity with python. Thanks :tada:

mona: I'll continue audit on retry/auth interceptors for double-encoding edge cases and file a PR if I find anything.

erin: Closing thread for onboarding; will follow DEVEX-5402 for CI parity.
